parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> You can move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-data-lake-table --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-input example-string --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise CreateDataLakeTable --region cn-hangzhou --TableInput 'example-string' --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --DbName default --Tid 3000 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
